summary: Chip sell-off is accelerating with the Nasdaq leading the Dow and S&P 500 lower after a hot annual PPI and continued Nvidia CEO fallout. Since 09:35: tape turned broadly red (Dow gave up gains), so chip puts get a small bump and AI/tech calls a small trim.

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Down ~3.6% near 160 under Thursday's 166.19 close as the chip sell-off accelerates on CEO turmoil; under 160 extends toward 156.5, back over 166.2 the put is wrong.

picks.name: Palo Alto Networks
picks.reason: KeyBanc upgrade plus a security bid from the Microsoft outage; still holding gains but a broadly red tape trims confidence a touch.

picks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
picks.reason: Chip sell-off accelerating with the Nasdaq leading losses; under 565 extends toward 553, over 581 the put is wrong.

picks.name: Cerebras Systems
picks.reason: Earnings beat, raised guide and Microsoft deal, but the accelerating chip sell-off weighs on AI names; under 112 the gap fails.

picks.name: Microsoft
picks.reason: Outlook outage ongoing but shares have recovered to near flat (Microsoft says no malicious activity); under 505 still extends, reclaim of 521 kills the put.

picks.name: Cisco Systems
picks.reason: Selling the news on its FQ1 beat; under the 97.70 low extends toward 96, back over 100.8 the fade fails.
